chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 341 – Zhuge Yuan: A Name That Terrifies the Chief Recorder
chapter_meta_description: A Zuowandao is dead. Li Huowang makes his first cold-blooded kill for the Office, then pays off a colleague. But when the name “Zhuge Yuan” is revealed, even the Chief Recorder flees in fear. The hunt for the Heart-Murk reveals a much larger game.
og_title: A New Player Emerges: The Scholar Zhuge Yuan
og_description: Li Huowang learns the rules of the Office: kill, bribe, and survive. But the mention of a mysterious scholar changes everything.
twitter_title: The Chief Recorder is afraid. Who is Zhuge Yuan? Ch. 341 breakdown.
twitter_description: Li Huowang kills a Zuowandao monk and slips a bribe to a colleague. But the name of the real thief has the Chief Recorder running scared.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-ranking eunuch official in the Supervisory Heavenly Office; their power is both bureaucratic and supernatural, often wielded through a deceptively genial demeanor.
A mysterious scholar whose name alone incites terror in the Chief Recorder. He is believed to have stolen the Heart-Murk from right under everyone's noses.
A supernatural currency used as a bribe; pills that extend or store one’s lifespan, making them extremely valuable in the Dao-Twisted World.
The previous location of the Heart-Murk hunt, now a site of mystery where Zhuge Yuan’s interference is suspected.
A grotesque parasitic entity that Li Huowang actively controls and weaponizes, using its tentacles to restrain his victims.
A ritual Daoist weapon composed of coins strung on red cord; Li Huowang can use it as both a flexible cord and a rigid sword.

cultural_notes_faq.a: A mysterious scholar whose name terrifies the Chief Recorder; he is believed to have stolen the Heart-Murk during the chaos at the Buddha Bone Temple.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Li Huowang kill Xin Chi?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He wanted to eliminate a threat and assert his own ruthless efficiency, framing it as an accident to avoid responsibility from the Chief Recorder.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Hong Da accept the bribe?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Office is a place of mutual benefit, not loyalty. A pile of Lifespan Pills was enough to ensure his cooperation and silence.
